name: manage_media
description: Search, read, and upload WordPress media attachments through one consolidated facade. Send search and read operations with GET. Send upload operations with POST so a read request cannot create an attachment.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Optional media action. Omit operation or use search for discovery with GET. Use GET for read. Use POST for upload.

parameters.name: mime_type
parameters.description: Optional mime type filter for operation=search, for example image/jpeg.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Optional requested image size for operation=search or read. Output reports REQUESTED_SIZE and the actual SELECTED_SIZE; WordPress can fall back to full.

parameters.name: image_data
parameters.description: Required POST body value for operation=upload. Supply a base64 image payload; data URLs are accepted.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Optional POST body filename for operation=upload.

parameters.name: alt
parameters.description: Optional POST body alt text for operation=upload.

output.description: Plain text media results with attachment ids, metadata, available sizes, requested and actual selected size URLs, or uploaded attachment details.
